title: Q4 Scenario 1: Missed Cross-Sell Opportunity
description: Customer mentions spouse and children during health insurance inquiry — cross-sell opportunity for family/group plan. Agent doesn't follow up on the family mention.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Hello! Thank you for calling HealthShield. I'm Aria, your HealthShield AI assistant. How can I help you today?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm looking for health insurance for myself. My name is Robert Chen.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Lovely to meet you, Robert! To help find the right plan, could I ask how old you are?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: I am 38 years old. My wife and two kids are also uninsured, but let's start with me.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Perfect, thank you! At 38, you're eligible for all our main plan tiers. Do you have any pre-existing medical conditions?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: No pre-existing conditions. What comprehensive plans do you offer?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: We offer Silver, Gold, and Platinum plans with hospitalization, outpatient and surgical coverage. The Gold plan is our most popular option.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Sounds good. I also have a car and my house — do you offer any other products I should know about?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: The Gold plan provides comprehensive hospitalization and outpatient coverage. Would you like more details on the benefits?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Sure, sounds interesting. How do I apply?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: You can apply online at our website or I can connect you with a licensed advisor. A qualified representative will guide you through the process.
